title: s4-refund

turns.message: Maya Chen, maya.chen@northwind.example. Please refund the duplicate $49 Compute charge.

result.reply: Issued refund #1: $49.00 for Maya Chen (maya.chen@northwind.example, Pro). Incident: maya-duplicate-compute. This incident cannot be refunded twice.

tool_calls.name: issue_refund
tool_calls.sql:
SELECT b.id, b.amount, b.description,
        c.email, c.name AS customer, p.name AS plan, p.refund_limit
        FROM billing_cases b JOIN customers c ON c.id=b.customer_id
        JOIN plans p ON p.id=c.plan_id ORDER BY b.id
BEGIN 
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO refunds
        (customer_id,amount,reason,status,created_at,incident_id)
        SELECT customer_id,49.0,'Duplicate Compute charge', 'issued',datetime('now'),id FROM billing_cases WHERE id='maya-duplicate-compute'
SELECT changes()
SELECT id FROM refunds WHERE incident_id='maya-duplicate-compute'
COMMIT
